info.title: Fed-BioMed Node HTTP API
info.description: API shared by the API-only and GUI launchers. Paths are relative to the server origin. JSON requests use Content-Type: application/json. Protected operations use bearer access tokens; refresh uses a refresh token. File paths refer to files on the node host, not the client. See the user guide for examples and Postman setup.

servers.description: Default local server; replace host, port and scheme for your deployment.

get.description: Administrator-only audit log search. current_page is zero-based; page_size is clamped to 1–2000. Date filtering defaults to a 5000-entry limit. researcher_id=__none__ selects entries without a researcher. Requires an administrator account.

schema.description: Non-positive values disable the explicit limit.
Inclusive timestamp: ISO 8601 or epoch seconds/milliseconds.
Inclusive timestamp: ISO 8601 or epoch seconds/milliseconds.

post.description: Administrator creates a regular user. confirm must equal password. Use change-role separately to grant administrator access. Requires an administrator account. New passwords need at least eight characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.

Creates a registration request for administrator approval, not an active account. confirm must equal password. Use POST; GET with a JSON body is retained only for compatibility. New passwords need at least eight characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.

get.description: Send the refresh token, not the access token, as Authorization: Bearer <refresh_token>. Returns a new access token and refresh token.

post.description: Registers a researcher certificate for node–researcher gRPC authentication. certificate is PEM text; component_id is optional when encoded in the certificate. Does not configure HTTPS. Requires an administrator account.
Generates a new node gRPC certificate/key pair and preserves backups. The researcher must register the replacement certificate. Requires an administrator account.
Inspects PEM certificate text without registering it. Requires an administrator account.

Replaces the node gRPC certificate and private key with PEM strings, preserving backups. Does not configure HTTPS. The researcher must register the replacement certificate. Requires an administrator account.
Registers existing server-side data; does not upload files. type is csv, images, or custom. path is an array of segments relative to --data-folder.

get.description: Returns sections with current values and field metadata, including editable flags; use these to construct PATCH requests.

patch.description: Read GET /api/node/config first for section names, editable fields and types. Send sections.<section>.values. Optional base_values detects concurrent edits (409); force bypasses that check. A running node may require restarting. Requires an administrator account.

base_values.description: Original values for each updated key. Omit to skip conflict detection.
